mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_token (user_id, token_hash, expires_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND, #{ttlSeconds}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)))
mapper.update: UPDATE refresh_token SET revoked_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
UPDATE refresh_token SET last_used_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT rt.id AS token_id, rt.user_id, rt.token_hash, rt.expires_at, rt.revoked_at, rt.last_used_at, u.email, u.display_name, u.role, u.status, u.created_at AS user_created_at FROM refresh_token rt JOIN app_user u ON u.id = rt.user_id WHERE rt.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND rt.revoked_at IS NULL AND rt.expires_at > UTC_TIMESTAMP(3)
